data.body_html:
Planning a marbella yacht charter hen party in 2034? Your budget breakdown starts here. Whether you're celebrating with 5 or 12 guests, our fleet offers transparent pricing from €749 for a 2-hour spin to €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. All charters depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. No surprises, just sun, sea, and sangria.

This guide covers boat costs, inclusions, and smart tips to maximise your hen party experience on the Costa del Sol. For a quick overview of all options, see our Marbella boat rental hub.

Boat options and pricing for hen parties

Your budget depends on group size and desired luxury. Here's a clear breakdown:

BoatMax paxPrice rangeBest for
Astondoa 40 / Azimut 399–11€749/2h – €2,299/8hSmall groups on a budget
Mangusta 80 (white or grey)12€4,719/4h (jet ski included)Luxury with added fun
Other boats (Azimut 58, Canados 86, etc.)10–12Pricing on request via WhatsAppCustom itineraries

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. No hidden extras.

What's included in every hen party charter

Every booking comes with a licensed skipper who knows the best spots for swimming and photos. Fuel is included, so you cruise without worrying about costs. Drinks: water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. Light snacks are served. Insurance and safety equipment are covered. Just bring your hen party energy.

Sample budget breakdown for 10 guests

Let's crunch numbers for a 4-hour charter on an Astondoa 40 (€1,499 for 4 hours):

  • Boat: €1,499
  • Optional catering (tapas platter): €200–€400
  • Decorations (balloons, banner): €50–€100
  • Gratuity for skipper: €50–€100 total
  • Total: €1,799–€2,099 (€180–€210 per person)

For a premium upgrade to a Mangusta 80 at €4,719/4h (including a free jet ski), per-person cost for 12 guests is €393. Add catering and tips, around €440 per person.

Best time of year for a hen party yacht charter

Peak season (June–September) offers 30°C water and 14 hours of daylight. Book 2–3 months ahead. Shoulder months (May, October) are cooler but quieter, with lower demand. Winter charters are possible but less popular for hen parties.

Top hen party itinerary ideas

Your skipper can tailor the route. Popular options:

  • 4-hour trip: Depart Puerto Banús, head south to Cala del Faro for swimming and cliff photos, then cruise past the Golden Mile back to port.
  • 6-hour trip: Add a stop at Cabopino or Cala Cortés, with time for lunch at a beach club.
  • 8-hour trip: Extend to Estepona or Sotogrande, with a full catering service on board.

For more route inspiration, check our blog.

How to book and what to ask

Booking is simple: choose your boat from our fleet page, then contact us via WhatsApp for availability and a deposit link. Ask about:

  • Catering options (tapas, paella, sushi)
  • DJ or sound system upgrades
  • Photographer for the day
  • Jet ski add-ons (for Tier A boats)

We'll confirm everything in writing, including cancellation policy.

Frequently asked questions

What is the cheapest boat for a hen party in Marbella in 2034?

The most budget-friendly option is the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, both Tier A boats at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. These fit 9–11 guests and include drinks, snacks, and skipper—ideal for a smaller hen party.

How many people can a hen party yacht hold?

Our fleet ranges from 5 pax on the Dubhe or Mariah SX21 up to 12 pax on larger yachts like the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, or Ferretti 94. Most hen parties book boats for 10–12 guests to keep costs per person low.

What is included in the hen party yacht charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees—just show up and enjoy.

Can we bring our own food or decorations?

Yes, you can bring your own food, cakes, or decorations. We recommend confirming with us via WhatsApp to ensure space on board. Many hen parties bring a personalised banner or balloons.

How far in advance should we book a hen party yacht in Marbella?

For peak season (June–September), book 2–3 months ahead, especially for popular boats like the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58. Off-peak, 2–4 weeks is usually sufficient.

What is the best itinerary for a hen party?

A classic 4-hour trip heads south to Cala del Faro for swimming and photos, then cruises past the Golden Mile. An 8-hour charter can include lunch at a beach club or a stop at Cabopino. Your skipper will tailor the route.

Are there any extra costs we should budget for?

The listed price is all-inclusive. Optional extras like a DJ, photographer, catering, or jet ski upgrade (on Tier A boats) cost extra—ask via WhatsApp for a quote. Gratuity for the skipper is discretionary.

Is the deposit refundable if we cancel?

Cancellation policies vary by boat and season. Typically, a 50% deposit is required, with full refund if cancelled 14+ days before. Contact us via WhatsApp for exact terms on your chosen boat.
